content: विभावः .²1 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Any condition which produces or develops a particular state of body or mind; (one of the three main divisions of {%Bhāvas%}, the other two being अनुभाव and व्यभिचारिभाव <ab>qq. vv.</ab>); रत्याद्युद्बोधका लोके विभावाः काव्यनाट्ययोः <ls>S. D. 62</ls>; its chief subdivisions are आलम्बन and उद्दीपक; see आलम्बन. .²2 A friend, an acquaintance. .²3 Any exciting circumstance (as dress <ab>&c.</ab>).
